name: Latvia
famous_for: Riga's world-class Art Nouveau architecture, UNESCO medieval cobblestone Old Town, Baltic amber, and nationwide Song festivals.
tourists: Over 1.8M tourists; famous for House of the Black Heads, Gauja National Park bobsleigh and castles, and Jūrmala sandy beaches.
must_know: Over one-third of the buildings in central Riga are built in the ornate Art Nouveau style, more than any other European capital.
fun_fact: Midsummer (Jāņi) on June 23-24 is Latvia's most cherished holiday, celebrated overnight around bonfires wearing oak-leaf and flower crowns.
